commentary.text: 90+5' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
90' 4 - 1 GOAL! Yannik Engelhardt meets a cross inside the box and heads the ball across the goal, where Nico Paz (Como) lurks and pokes it into the back of the net. 4:1.
88' The linesman raises his flag. Jordan Zemura (Udinese) is adjudged offside.
87' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Udinese.
83' Jaka Bijol (Udinese) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
81' Jurgen Ekkelenkamp (Udinese) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
81' The game has come to an end for Lucas Da Cunha. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Maximo Perrone (Como).
80' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Patrick Cutrone trots off the pitch and is replaced by Yannik Engelhardt (Como).
79' Kosta Runjaic prepares a substitution. Florian Thauvin is replaced by Iker Bravo (Udinese).
79' Substitution. Arthur Atta (Udinese) on for Martin Payero.
78' 3 - 1 What bad luck! Jaka Bijol (Udinese) got in the way of a pass and unintentionally sent the ball past his own goalkeeper. The score is 3:1.
77' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Udinese comes to nothing.
77' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Florian Thauvin (Udinese). Udinese have been awarded a corner kick.
74' Patrick Cutrone (Como) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender.
72' Rough tackle by Thomas Kristensen (Udinese). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
69' Sandi Lovric (Udinese) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Jean Butez intercepts the ball.
68' Alieu Fadera (Como) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and fires in a shot that heads towards the middle of the goal, but Razvan Sava makes a comfortable save.
65' Substitution. Rui Modesto leaves the pitch and is replaced by Jurgen Ekkelenkamp (Udinese).
63' RED CARD! Oumar Solet (Udinese) makes a bad challenge and receives a second yellow card from Francesco Cosso. He can have an early bath.
62' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Fellipe Jack (Como) is coming onto the pitch as Gabriel Strefezza cannot continue after picking up an injury.
61' Cesc Fabregas has decided to make a change. Nico Paz (Como) replaces Maxence Caqueret.
59' Oumar Solet (Udinese) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Francesco Cosso had an easy-decision to make.
57' Edoardo Goldaniga (Como) should have been more careful. He commits a bad foul, receives his second yellow card and is sent-off!
56' Rui Modesto (Udinese) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a low shot in the direction of the left post. Jean Butez is alert and denies him with a nice save.
54' Florian Thauvin (Udinese) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Como.
51' Edoardo Goldaniga (Como) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
50' 2 - 1 GOAL! Martin Payero (Udinese) gets to the ball on the edge of the box after a huge mistake by an opponent and slams it into the back of the net. He makes it 2:1.
49' Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle.
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Alexis Sanchez is replaced by Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese).
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Kosta Runjaic gives a chance to Jordan Zemura (Udinese) and Hassane Kamara is off.
46' The whistle blows and Francesco Cosso starts the second half.
45+3' The end of the first half.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
44' 2 - 0 Gabriel Strefezza (Como) doesn't hesitate to lash home from just outside the box. He hits the ball precisely into the bottom right corner and it nestles in the net.
44' Gabriel Strefezza (Como) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
42' Sandi Lovric (Udinese) was close to scoring after he unleashed a powerful shot which went a whisker wide of the right post.
40' The referee can't ignore those comments and Cesc Fabregas (Como) sees a yellow card for bad language.
36' Hassane Kamara (Udinese) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Francesco Cosso blows for a foul.
35' Hassane Kamara (Udinese) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Jean Butez, who smothers the ball.
33' A rebound falls kindly for Sandi Lovric (Udinese), but his shot from the edge of the box flies high over bar. None too pretty!
31' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Assane Diao (Como) heads on.
29' Cesc Fabregas is forced to make a change. Ignace Van der Brempt is unable to continue due to injury, Alessio Iovine (Como) comes on.
27' Ignace Van der Brempt (Como) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.

27' Alieu Fadera (Como) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the middle of the goal is, however, saved by Razvan Sava!
27' Rui Modesto (Udinese) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it.
21' Alexis Sanchez (Udinese) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him.
20' Martin Payero (Udinese) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Francesco Cosso saw the whole situation.
19' Rui Modesto (Udinese) sends a cross into the box, but Jean Butez comes off his line to gather the ball.
17' Assane Diao (Como) rises highest from the corner to head at goal, but his effort towards the bottom left corner is brilliantly kept out by the goalkeeper.
17' Gabriel Strefezza (Como) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.

16' Maxence Caqueret (Como) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and smashes a glorious looking effort towards the roof of the net, but Razvan Sava thwarts him with a great two-handed save. The referee signals a corner kick to Como.
16' Como quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
15' The game is interrupted now, Rui Modesto (Udinese) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
14' Ignace Van der Brempt (Como) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away. Good work from Como as they win a corner.
11' Francesco Cosso has a clear sight and sees a foul from Ignace Van der Brempt (Como).
9' Lucas Da Cunha (Como) unleashes a shot, but it's well wide of the left-hand post.
9' Flag up against Alexis Sanchez (Udinese). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
5' 1 - 0 Goal! Assane Diao (Como) takes a short pass from Gabriel Strefezza in his stride in the box, jinks inside his man and unleashes an unstoppable shot into the roof of the net. 1:0.
3' Martin Payero (Udinese) was too forceful with his tackle and Francesco Cosso interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
2' Florian Thauvin (Udinese) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Udinese will kick-off.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
Show lineups
Today's referee will be Francesco Cosso.
